headline: Does Strong Q2 Earnings and Higher Payouts Change The Bull Case For State Street (STT)?
summary: State Street Corporation recently reported second-quarter 2026 results, with net income rising to US$1.08 billion and diluted EPS from continuing operations at US$3.65, alongside confirming completion of a large share repurchase program and declaring higher common and preferred dividends.
